CREATE VIEW d09_v_store_month AS
SELECT
  ss_store_sk,
  d.d_year,
  d.d_moy,
  SUM(ss_net_paid) AS net_paid,
  COALESCE(SUM(ss_coupon_amt), 0) AS coupons,
  CONCAT_WS(
    '-',
    COALESCE(CAST(d.d_year AS VARCHAR), ''),
    COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(d.d_moy AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'), '')
  ) AS ym
FROM store_sales AS ss
JOIN date_dim AS d
  ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE
  d.d_year = 2001
GROUP BY
  ss_store_sk,
  d.d_year,
  d.d_moy
